headline: Riga bring the form, Pafos bring the price
summary: Riga arrive unbeaten in five, with four wins and 2.45 expected goals a game — real chances, not luck. Pafos, though, are clear 59.5% favourites, more than three times Riga's 17.3%. The reasons: Pafos' one heavy defeat was 1-3 at Atalanta, the toughest side here, and Sunday's 0-0 at home to Apoel Nicosia left them three days to recover. The handicap — a head start in goals — rates Pafos about a goal better, 0.9, up from 0.83. The goal line is 2.75, with over at 49.1%. Form says Riga; the price says Pafos.
read: Pafos are clear favourites at 59.5% to beat Riga and are rated about a goal the better side on a -1 handicap, strengthened on the handicap in the last 24 hours. Riga are the form team, unbeaten in five with 2.45 xG a game, while Pafos come off a 0-0 with Apoel on three days' rest and a 1-3 defeat at Atalanta in their opener.

facts.fact: Pafos are clear favourites at 59.5% to win, more than three times Riga's 17.3% chance.
facts.meaning: More likely than not Pafos take the three points, and the market sees a wide gap between the sides.

facts.fact: Riga arrive unbeaten in five — four wins and a draw, seven goals scored and two conceded.
facts.meaning: The form book points the opposite way to the price, which makes this the most interesting game of their phase so far.

facts.fact: The market's price on Pafos covering the -1 handicap (winning by two or more) rose from 44.7% to 46.9% in the last 24 hours.
facts.meaning: Pafos are rated about a full goal the better side, and that rating has strengthened rather than faded before kick-off.

facts.fact: Pafos were held 0-0 at home by Apoel Nicosia on Sunday, three days before this match.
facts.meaning: A short turnaround and a blank afternoon in front of goal; they have scored five goals in their last five games.

facts.fact: Pafos lost their opener 1-3 at Atalanta, creating 0.91 xG against 3.47.
facts.meaning: The chance creation, not just the scoreline, was one-sided — but Atalanta are the strongest side in this group of fixtures.

facts.fact: Pafos sit 32nd of 36 in the league phase with zero points from their opening match.
facts.meaning: A home fixture is exactly where they need to start climbing, and Riga arrive only one point better off.

facts.fact: The goal line is 2.75, with the market splitting the match either side of three goals.
facts.meaning: Two goals pays the under, three goals pays a half win on the over — the market expects a game in the two-to-three range.

facts.fact: Both teams to score is priced at 53.2%, just over a coin flip.
facts.meaning: The market leans to both sides finding the net, but only slightly — it is not a conviction call.

sources.fact: Pafos lost their opening Conference League league-phase match and have zero points, so they are chasing their first win of the phase against Riga.
Around 4,000 Pafos fans are reported to be travelling to Limassol to support the team in the European match.
Riga have scored at least one goal in each of their last 10 matches across all competitions, according to Spanish betting media.
Riga travel to Cyprus aiming to keep collecting points in their second Conference League league-phase match.
